title: How Are LLMs Mitigating Stereotyping Harms? Learning from Search Engine Studies
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of the eight primary social group categories used to evaluate stereotyping harms. It benchmarks LLM performance (refusal rates, toxicity, sentiment, and regard) across various religious groups including Atheists, Buddhists, Catholics, Christians, Hindus, Jews, Mormons, Muslims, Protestants, and Sikhs.
